title: RavynOS: Pre-alpha open-source OS based on Darwin, FreeBSD, Apple open-source
summary: RavynOS is a pre-alpha open-source operating system project that aims to create a macOS-like desktop experience by combining Apple's Darwin kernel, FreeBSD components, and other Apple open-source projects into a fully open-source system.
problem_solved: Provides an open-source alternative for users seeking a modern, macOS-inspired desktop experience without proprietary dependencies.
why_valuable: Offers the computing community a chance to study, modify, and distribute a Darwin/FreeBSD-based system while giving users more freedom in their operating system choices.
